headline.purpose: Main task title; 25px at mobile sizes.

label.purpose: File rows, removal choices and helper actions.

motion.name: control-transform
motion.purpose: Button transform transition; fine-pointer press scales to 0.98.

motion.name: control-background
motion.purpose: Primary and secondary button background transition.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transition durations become zero under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The explicit selection or cleaning action.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;min-height:40px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:7px;font:550 14px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1),background-color 140ms ease;background:var(--accent,#22634b);color:var(--surface,#ffffff);}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#257451);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-primary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.48}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-primary:not(:disabled):hover{background:var(--accent-hover,#194d3b)}.ds-primary:not(:disabled):active{transform:scale(.98)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition-duration:0s}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;min-height:40px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:7px;font:550 14px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1),background-color 140ms ease;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#232b27);border-color:var(--line,#dce2dc);}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#257451);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-secondary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.48}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-secondary:not(:disabled):hover{background:var(--layer,#f0f3ef)}.ds-secondary:not(:disabled):active{transform:scale(.98)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition-duration:0s}}

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Underlined selection helper without a filled surface.

components.name: Metadata Search
components.description: Labeled metadata filtering field with an inline stroke icon.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input aria-label="Filter metadata" type="search" placeholder="Find a field or value…"/></label>
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--muted,#59665e);border:1px solid var(--line,#dce2dc);background:var(--surface,#ffffff);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif}.ds-search input{min-width:0;width:100%;border:0;color:var(--ink,#232b27);background:transparent;font:400 12px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;caret-color:var(--accent,#22634b)}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#59665e)}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#257451);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: File Navigation
components.description: The selected image remains explicit in the session rail.

components.name: Metadata Family Tag
components.description: A passive container label, not an interactive filter.

components.name: Drop Target
components.description: The empty-state file target; the visible button is the keyboard entry.
components.html:
See what your images reveal

Drop your images here to inspect location, camera details and other embedded information.

JPEG, PNG, WebP · TIFF inspection only
components.css: .ds-drop{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;min-height:290px;padding:36px 24px;border:1px dashed #a3b3a7;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#232b27);border-radius:12px;gap:16px;font:400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif}.ds-drop h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:620;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:0 0 7px}.ds-drop p{margin:0;color:var(--muted,#59665e);max-width:50ch}.ds-drop .ds-formats{font-size:12px}.ds-drop.ds-dragging{background:var(--accent-soft,#eaf3ee);border-color:var(--accent,#22634b)}.ds-drop-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;min-height:40px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:7px;font:550 14px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1),background-color 140ms ease;background:var(--accent,#22634b);color:var(--surface,#ffffff);}.ds-drop-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#257451);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-drop-button:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.48}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-drop-button:not(:disabled):hover{background:var(--accent-hover,#194d3b)}.ds-drop-button:not(:disabled):active{transform:scale(.98)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-drop-button{transition-duration:0s}}

components.name: Original / Cleaned Switch
components.description: Two pressed-state buttons compare inspection of the same file.
components.css: .ds-switch{display:inline-flex;padding:3px;background:var(--layer,#f0f3ef);border-radius:7px}.ds-switch button{padding:5px 10px;font:400 12px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;border:0;border-radius:4px;color:var(--muted,#59665e);background:transparent;cursor:pointer}.ds-switch button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#232b27)}.ds-switch button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#257451);outline-offset:3px;}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-switch button:active{transform:scale(.98)}}

components.name: Verified Result
components.description: Explicit reopening/verification feedback with a separate output action.
components.html:
Cleaned copy verified

3 selected containers removed · Required rotation retained

Metadata containers: 4 before → 1 after.
components.css: .ds-verified{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;padding:16px;background:var(--accent-soft,#eaf3ee);color:var(--accent,#22634b);border-radius:6px;font:400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-verified>svg{flex-shrink:0;margin-top:2px}.ds-verified>div{flex:1}.ds-verified strong{font-size:13px;font-weight:700}.ds-verified p{font-size:11px;margin:3px 0 0}.ds-download{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;min-height:40px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:7px;font:550 14px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1),background-color 140ms ease;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#232b27);border-color:var(--line,#dce2dc);}.ds-download:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#257451);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-download:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.48}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-download:not(:disabled):hover{background:var(--layer,#f0f3ef)}.ds-download:not(:disabled):active{transform:scale(.98)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-download{transition-duration:0s}}.ds-download{min-height:34px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:12px}

narrative.overview:
The workspace makes the hidden contents of an image legible and keeps the next action explicit. The user-pinned Emil Kowalski + Impeccable direction lands as a compact English utility: warm green-gray neutrals, a restrained forest-green action and native controls. The working file and its information supply the visual interest.

The system uses plain hierarchy, hairline separators and tonal state changes. Light and dark modes preserve the same semantic roles. Local system typography supports the product's no-remote-font commitment. Motion is limited to brief control feedback; there are no entrance animations.
keyCharacteristics: Compact type and readable metadata rows.
Green actions and selected states; amber exposure cues.
Flat surfaces separated by tone and hairlines.
Explicit original/cleaned comparison and verified downloads.
Native controls, visible keyboard focus and stacked mobile flow.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Use green for actions, selection and verified results, amber for exposure or limits, and red for processing errors; retain a textual state cue.

rules.name: The Data Legibility Rule
rules.body: Preserve tabular numerals and wrapping for technical values; truncate only compact rail filenames, while the selected file heading wraps.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate working areas with tone and hairlines; express selection through semantic fills rather than added shadows.

dos: **Do** use semantic theme properties so light and dark surfaces preserve the same roles.
**Do** keep technical values readable with tabular numerals, wrapping and plain field labels.
**Do** pair sensitive, error and verified colors with explicit text.
**Do** retain native controls, accessible labels, visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** keep cleaning rules beside their action and expose the removal link near the loaded privacy summary.
donts: **Don't** replace the compact workspace with promotional heroes or decorative dashboard cards.
**Don't** add decorative shadows, gradients, remote fonts or entrance animations to this settled utility direction.
**Don't** turn test fixture imagery into a recurring UI illustration or claim it is a shipping brand asset.
**Don't** use color alone to claim metadata has been removed; preserve explicit verification and original/cleaned inspection.
